architecture.expected_effect: Restore model performance by establishing a stable reference point for comparison and enabling continuous calibration against industry standards
architecture.falsification_test: Compare the performance of the benchmarked model against the original model performance before the redesign using offline replay on the same dataset, measuring normalized discounted cumulative gain and click-through rates
